name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flatTests_iff
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type} (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ)
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
  (a : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.k γ) → A) (d : A),
  Iff (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.FlatTests γ d (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extend γ I a d))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Valid (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testTerms γ hv) I a)

source.code:
/-- The variable tests on the extension are the original term tests. -/
theorem flatTests_iff (hv : γ.Valid) (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A)
    (a : Fin γ.k → A) (d : A) :
    γ.FlatTests d (γ.extend I a d) ↔ DisequalityDispersion.Valid (γ.testTerms hv) I a := by
  have htests := (γ.valid_iff.mp hv).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  unfold FlatTests DisequalityDispersion.Valid testTerms
  simp only [List.forall_mem_map]
  constructor
  · intro h ij hij
    have := h ij hij
    rwa [γ.bval_extend hv I a d _ (htests ij hij).1, γ.bval_extend hv I a d _ (htests ij hij).2]
      at this
  · intro h ij hij
    rw [γ.bval_extend hv I a d _ (htests ij hij).1, γ.bval_extend hv I a d _ (htests ij hij).2]
    exact h ij hij
